Police encounter injures accused in Batala, SI shot in Patna

In Batala, Punjab, an accused in a kidnapping and firing case was injured in a police encounter. He was taken for recovery of evidence when he allegedly fired at the police and attempted to escape. In Patna, Bihar, police encountered criminals involved in illegal sand mining. During the exchange of fire, which involved 62 rounds, a Sub-Inspector was shot and injured, and the criminals were also wounded.
